A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BANet and contain readable main text and complete supplementary material. The equations, six figures and six tables can be reliably matched despite pagination and reference changes.

before.justification: V1 reports original BANet evaluations on Scene Flow and KITTI, component ablations, mobile latency measurements and supplementary reflective-region results.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results, including Tables 1–6 and the supplementary qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same bilateral aggregation branches, scale-aware attention, MobileNetV2 backbone, disparity prediction, upsampling and loss. The BANet-3D extension is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain ImageNet pretraining and the same Scene Flow Finalpass and KITTI 2012/2015 coverage, including reflective regions. Newly cited depth-completion, monocular-depth and optical-flow work does not introduce evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the benchmark tables, BA integration comparisons and qualitative figures. LightStereo-L already appears in v1 Table 3; newly cited methods such as FoundationStereo are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.4, Figure 1 and Tables 1, 3 and 4 change the reported complexity metric from FLOPs to MACs (Multiply-Accumulate Operations), retaining the numerical counts and input resolutions. Other stated training and evaluation settings match; this does not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The BA/SSA ablations, foreground analysis, integration into PSMNet/GwcNet/Fast-ACVNet+, reflective-region evaluation and detailed-versus-smooth branch visualizations are retained. Supplementary Sections 6.1–6.3 add no new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. Statistical reporting practices remain unchanged throughout the main text and supplement.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 retain the same numerical entries and rankings, and the qualitative results match. BANet-2D/3D Scene Flow EPE remains 0.57/0.51, KITTI 2015 D1-all remains 1.83%/1.77%, and mobile latency remains 45 ms. Complexity counts are relabeled but not numerically revised.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7 retain the same definitions of volume separation, aggregation, attention, correlation, disparity regression and loss. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The core contributions and performance claims remain: bilateral aggregation, scale-aware attention, accurate mobile stereo and the BANet-3D extension. V2 removes the attention and BANet-3D sentences from the abstract, but both claims remain explicit in the introduction.

C2.justification: V1's Section 3 overview explains that 3D aggregation preserves the disparity dimension and thereby supports accuracy; v2 omits this specific mechanism explanation. Interpretations of branch complementarity, reflective-region performance and mobile deployment limitations otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Architecture details, PyTorch/RTX 3090 implementation, training schedule, hyperparameters, image cropping and mobile latency breakdown are retained. The code link differs only in username capitalization, with no documented change in resource availability.

R1.justification: V2 adds 12 references and removes three, including additions such as Stereo Anywhere, FoundationStereo and Metric3D v2. The introduction broadens its context to depth completion and monocular depth, while the main positioning against existing stereo aggregation methods remains stable.

P1.justification: V2 shortens the abstract and Section 3 overview, rewrites the opening introduction, adds an Optics Valley Laboratory affiliation and acknowledgements, and makes small wording edits. Most prose and the section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures and tables remain. Complexity labels change to MACs, Figure 1's caption is shortened, Table 5 moves from page 8 to page 7, and Figure 4 is slightly reduced. These are limited display and layout changes.

improvement.justification: V2 updates contextual references, shortens exposition and relabels computational complexity while retaining the same method, experimental evidence and reproducibility information, including the supplement. These limited refinements, alongside a small loss of explanatory detail, leave the paper's overall clarity and scientific support materially unchanged.
